title: God works it for good

verses.text: And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
As for you, what you intended against me for evil, God intended for good, in order to accomplish a day like this—to preserve the lives of many people.
“Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh. Is anything too difficult for Me?

caption:
Nothing in your life is wasted on God.

Joseph could name the harm done to him and still see God working through it. That does not make the wound good. It means the wound is not the last word on your story.

Romans 8:28, Genesis 50:20, Jeremiah 32:27 (BSB)

Save this for the day the story feels stuck. Send it to someone who is still waiting to see why.
